notes.title: Drăculești - Now On Kickstarter (+ Demo Audio Update)
notes.content:
Welcome back to Castle Dracula.



It's been a month since our Next Fest update, and we've used that time to improve some of the rougher scenes in Dracula and the Ghost's extended story segments. In particular, the audio for the General's appearances and the audio for the piano scene have been given a major overhaul. It's crucial that a musical talent like our Ghost be provided the best tools, and his old piano simply wasn't up to snuff! Perhaps it was all the bones Dracula left in it. How impolite.



In addition to our audio update, we are excited to announce our Drăculești Kickstarter campaign, which is live until August 9th!


[previewyoutube="qwpmRATtlzM;full"][/previewyoutube]


This campaign will cover finishing costs for the game, as well as the cost of partial voice acting. We have announced the first two actors in our exciting cast - Ray Chase as Dracula and Erika Ishii as Cez - and there are plenty more to come over the following weeks.



Back Us On Kickstarter



Our campaign page is over here, with plenty of tantalising rewards for backers. We hope you'll support us so we can finish the game to the best possible quality! And, if you're unable to back the campaign for whatever reason, sharing it widely is valuable to us too. Tell all the gays, Goths, and gay Goths you know about Drăculești!



We'll likely have a few further QOL updates over the following weeks. In the meantime, we're sure the Ghost will play some lovely waiting music for you, now he's operating at the height of his power.



Eternally yours,

The Fiends

notes.title: Next Fest Demo - Patch 1.5.1
notes.content:
We've just completed some minor renovations to Castle Dracula, to improve the visitor experience. Thank you everyone for stopping by over Next Fest, and please spread the word if you've had a pleasant trip!



Inventory image update; Renfield can now stuff his pockets full of someone else's fingers.

New gallery images; the man in the basement and the woman in the portrait now appear correctly in the game gallery.

Typo corrections; there are a lot of words and some of them weren't quite right!

Restored missing dream image; no, Renfield wasn't seeing things, we just deleted a file by accident.

Replaced 'possession' image; it's worse now. There's goo. Always practice safe seances.



We hope you continue to enjoy the company of Dracula, Ghost, Cez, and Jonny. Have a wonderful Next Fest!

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Now Live
notes.content:
It's Next Fest, and Drăculești is taking part!

[previewyoutube="_OqffQdQiF8;full"][/previewyoutube]
Whether you're a new arrival or a returning guest, there's never been a better time to visit Castle Dracula.



Our Next Fest demo contains new story sequences and a number of QOL updates on our previous demo. Check out the feature list below, and make sure to try it sometime this week!


Next Fest Demo Features
45~ minutes each of new story content for Dracula and the Ghost; accessible by playing through their introductions as before; new scenes continue on from where the old ending was

A fresh soundtrack; from the menu down, enjoy a bevy of new and original compositions by our wonderful composer, Katarzyna Wiktorski 

Updated sprites; Dracula's hair has, as if by magic, become more luscious and beautiful - and Nico can finally put her hat on

New art; Jonny's got his own character visual

Miscellaneous bug fixes; we got Renfield to eat them. Thanks Renfield!

You can die in this one; wait what



Please note that we cannot guarantee old saves will work, as we introduced some new variables to old scenes. If you're running into trouble loading a save, you might need to start over.



Enjoy your latest trip to Castle Dracula, and... hey, what's that noise coming from the basement?



... Hey...?



H-

notes.title: Happy Steam Scream Fest 3!
notes.content:
Happy Steam Scream Fest 3!

To celebrate the spooky season, we've recently updated our demo with bug fixes and new art assets in several key sequences.


NVL mode displays transitions correctly
'Hunt' sequence features new artwork
'Breakfast' sequence features new artwork
UI has been adjusted to provide clearer distinction between narration and spoken dialogue
Twitch integration tutorialisation has been reworded, and UI has been adjusted
Tutorial has been reworded for clarity
Minor adjustments for many backgrounds, overlays, and other art assets

These improvements are sure to make your stay in Castle Dracula more comfortable! We encourage you to pay it a visit this Halloween.
